Arrived at response location, poi had already left the area.

Response call from Movenpick, reported a vagrant sleeping behind their building, requesting assistance to move them along.
We notified Auckland Council about the individual sleeping near Movenpick; they had managed to sort it out prior to us notifying them.
Continuing our patrols due to no concerns identified.
Arrived at the corner of Albert and Wellesley Street intersection, no issues spotted.
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square, full sweep around the location ensuring no vagrants or concerns present. Welfare check along Aotea Centre and Jack's Fried Chicken, all clear.
Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities visible. Ending Alpha Route now.

Welfare check inside Queens Food Court, all clear.
Welfare check along Munster Inn and Nandos, all clear.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, area has been thoroughly checked, no issues found.
Commencing welfare checks and sweeps along Lorne Street stores and businesses.

Response call from Lovisa Jewelry, reported a female individual who walked in, quickly grabbed some earrings and walked out without purchasing the items. Unable to capture a photo of the person of interest's face but have a photo description of what she is wearing. Last seen walking down towards Britomart.
Arrived at response location, poi had already disappeared from their site. Last seen heading down Queen Street.
Photo of the female has been retrieved but only captures the back of the poi. We will keep an eye out for anyone matching the description. (Posted onto Auror.)
Completed a full sweep down to corner of Vulcan Lane and High Street, wrapping around to Freyberg Place, unsuccessful in search of the theft from Lovisa Jewelry.
Arrived at check-in Chancery Square, full sweep completed around the area making sure no issues are present. Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls to arise.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities or issues visible.
Arrived at check-in Wilson's Carpark, welfare checks completed on static guards and stores within the area, all clear.
Arrived at check-in bottom of Fort Street, welfare checks completed on all stores within the area, no issues reported or found. Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities or concerns present.
Arrived at check-in Kiwi Bank, welfare checks commenced along all stores nearby, no issues found.

Arrived at last check-in Commercial Bay, full scope of the location has been completed, no issues found. Standing by to ensure our presence is visible and known to the public and stores within the area.
Response call from McDonald's Queen, reported a male vagrant arguing back and forth with the store manager about an order.

Arrived at response location McDonald's Queen. On arrival the poi was visibly having a verbal altercation with the staff manager. After de-escalating the situation we resolved the issue with solid evidence through CCTV footage that does not back the poi's statement of ordering food. Footage shows the poi grabbing a receipt from the bin and walking straight to the counter without ordering food. We asked the poi to leave due to complaints and he was verbally trespassed from the store, notified that if he did not comply a written trespass notice following a police notice would be issued. He complied and walked out without further issues. (Posted to Auror.)

Across from McDonald's Queen at Smith and Caugheys, we saw items and belongings sitting in front of the store without anyone present. We notified Auckland Council Wardens to make their way here to collect the belongings or send a truck. Items were on private property, out of their jurisdiction, so we moved them into public space, freeing up the Smith and Caugheys entrance way. (Photos provided.)
Council Wardens have now arrived; leaving the matter to them to handle.
Now leaving our presence from McDonald's Queen.
Patrolling down Queen Street we found a very suspicious male individual walking into Footlocker; staff waved us down to standby in case further issues arise.
Standing by to show our presence and waiting on further updates.
Poi has now left the store without causing any issues. Following the poi down Queen Street with some distance behind him for further issues.
Poi has now entered Nike; staff also saw us visibly keeping an eye on him and gave us the thumbs up to wait for any issues that may occur.
Poi has now left Nike. He is now heading down Queen Street.
Arrived at HQ, taking a quick break before continuing our patrols. Ending Echo Route now.
Break concluded, continuing our patrols now.
Arrived at check-in Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear. Stopped by to grab some drinks before moving along.
Arrived at check-in Top of Victoria Street, still no concerns identified. Standby to show our presence before continuing our patrols.
Patrolling down Albert Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Welfare check along Chemist Warehouse Wyndham Street, all clear.
Keeping our presence within Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible and making check-ins on stores and businesses.
Welfare check through Canterbury Arcade, all clear.
Welfare checks completed along Durham Street stores, all clear.
Arrived at HQ, taking our lunch break now and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Received a call from Queen Street McDonald's reporting a vagrant male sleeping inside the store for a few hours.

Arrived at Queen Street McDonald's; the vagrant male was still sleeping inside the lobby. We woke him up and told him to move along; he woke up and complied, walking outside the store without any further issues.
Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone and do our floor checks.
Welfare check on our guards at the car park next to Chemist Warehouse; everything's fine.
